## Release types (for rollback and smoke tests)
| Type | Rollback | Smoke |
|---|---|---|
| Server redeploy (web/API) | redeploy the newest verified release tag | per change type (core §3) |
| Mobile store | none autonomous (G6); staged rollout / feature flag off | device smoke on the release build |
| Package/CLI | yank + publish previous version — owner gate | install + one command in a clean environment |
| Infrastructure apply | none autonomous (G6) | plan/apply dry run + health check |
| Data/ML model | switch back to the previous model artefact | evaluation set within declared tolerances |
